clauses: Calculate each invoice’s ratio by averaging its line-level total-cost-to-unit-price ratios.
Calculate each invoice’s ratio by dividing summed total cost by summed unit prices.
Calculate each invoice’s ratio by dividing average line total cost by average line unit price.
readings: For each invoice, look at its average line product cost (`derived_product_cost`) and its ratio of total cost (`derived_total_cost`) to unit price (`product_price`), ignoring missing values. Take the invoices whose ratio is above the average ratio across all invoices. In a single row, what are their average product cost, their average ratio, and on average how far their ratio sits above that overall average? No rounding. queries:
WITH invoice_averages AS (
    SELECT
        i.invoice_number,
        AVG(li.derived_product_cost) AS average_product_cost,
        AVG(li.derived_total_cost / NULLIF(li.product_price, 0)) AS average_ratio
    FROM Invoices AS i
    LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS li
        ON li.invoice_number = i.invoice_number
    GROUP BY i.invoice_number
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_ratio) AS average_ratio
    FROM invoice_averages
)
SELECT
    AVG(ia.average_product_cost) AS average_product_cost,
    AVG(ia.average_ratio) AS average_ratio,
    AVG(ia.average_ratio - o.average_ratio) AS average_excess_ratio
FROM invoice_averages AS ia
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE ia.average_ratio > o.average_ratio

WITH invoice_averages AS (
    SELECT
        i.invoice_number,
        AVG(li.derived_product_cost) AS average_product_cost,
        1.0 * SUM(li.derived_total_cost) / NULLIF(SUM(li.product_price), 0) AS ratio
    FROM Invoices AS i
    LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS li
        ON li.invoice_number = i.invoice_number
    GROUP BY i.invoice_number
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS average_ratio
    FROM invoice_averages
)
SELECT
    AVG(ia.average_product_cost) AS average_product_cost,
    AVG(ia.ratio) AS average_ratio,
    AVG(ia.ratio - o.average_ratio) AS average_amount_above_overall
FROM invoice_averages AS ia
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE ia.ratio > o.average_ratio

WITH invoice_averages AS (
    SELECT
        i.invoice_number,
        AVG(li.derived_product_cost) AS average_product_cost,
        AVG(li.derived_total_cost) / AVG(li.product_price) AS ratio
    FROM Invoices AS i
    LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS li
        ON li.invoice_number = i.invoice_number
    GROUP BY i.invoice_number
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS average_ratio
    FROM invoice_averages
)
SELECT
    AVG(ia.average_product_cost) AS average_product_cost,
    AVG(ia.ratio) AS average_ratio,
    AVG(ia.ratio - oa.average_ratio) AS average_amount_above_overall
FROM invoice_averages AS ia
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
WHERE ia.ratio > oa.average_ratio
